name: Night Goblins

specialRules.name: Animosity
specialRules.text: At the beginning of each Night Goblin turn roll a D12; on a 1-2 they squabble and do nothing else for the rest of the turn. Trolls, Squigs, Snotlings and other non-goblins are not affected.

specialRules.name: Hate Stunties
specialRules.text: Night Goblins are subject to hatred towards Dwarfs. Fanatics are not affected.

equipmentLists.name: Night Goblin equipment list
equipmentLists.usedBy: Big Boss, Shaman, Bosses, Night Goblins

items.name: Madcap Mushrooms
items.note: Common (all Night Goblins). Rules as Mordheim rulebook.

items.name: Poison daggers
items.note: Common (Fanatics only). Pair of daggers coated in Death Cap juice, re-applied free after every game; same effect as Black Lotus.

items.name: Ball & chain
items.note: Common (Fanatics only). Rules as Mordheim Annual 2002.

items.name: Madcap Mushrooms
items.note: Common. Fanatics must buy them each game.

fighters.name: Big Boss

specialRules.name: Leader
specialRules.text: Any model in the warband within 6" of the Big Boss may use his Leadership instead of their own.

fighters.notes: PDF text for weapons: 'weapons from the Night Goblin equipment list'.

specialRules.name: Wizard
specialRules.text: Wizard; uses Waaagh! Magic as listed in the Mordheim Annual 2002.

specialRules.name: Animosity
specialRules.text: At the beginning of each Night Goblin turn roll a D12; on a 1-2 they squabble and do nothing else for the rest of the turn. Only Night Goblins are affected.

specialRules.name: Hate Stunties
specialRules.text: Subject to hatred towards Dwarfs (Night Goblins only).

specialRules.name: Addict
specialRules.text: Needs Madcap Mushrooms bought each game; without them he stays out of the battle.

specialRules.name: Mushroom Brain
specialRules.text: Cannot gain experience.

specialRules.name: Looney
specialRules.text: Subject to Frenzy. Tests for permanent damage after the battle as described in the rulebook.

specialRules.name: Frantic
specialRules.text: Strikes first in combat, ignoring penalties or bonuses for weapons or initiative order.

fighters.name: Cave Squig
fixedEquipment: Natural weapons (never uses weapons or armour)

specialRules.name: Movement
specialRules.text: No set Movement: moves 2D6". Never runs or declares charges; may contact enemies within its 2D6" move and then counts as charging.

specialRules.name: Minderz
specialRules.text: Must stay within 6" of a Night Goblin at the start of its Movement phase or goes wild: moves 2D6" in a random direction each turn, fights any model it contacts, and is out of the player's control for the rest of the game.

specialRules.name: Animals
specialRules.text: Do not gain experience.

fighters.notes: Movement is 2D6" (M recorded as 0). Never more Cave Squigs than Night Goblins.

fighters.name: Troll
fixedEquipment: None (never given weapons or armour; may carry a big club)

specialRules.name: Fear
specialRules.text: Causes fear.

specialRules.name: Stupidity
specialRules.text: Subject to stupidity.

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.text: When wounded roll a D12; on 7+ the wound is ignored. Not vs fire or fire-based magic. Never rolls for injury after battle.

specialRules.name: Dumb Monsters
specialRules.text: Never learns skills or gains experience.

specialRules.name: Always Hungry
specialRules.text: Upkeep 15gc after every game; the Big Boss may instead sacrifice three Snotlings or two Cave Squigs. If unpaid the Troll wanders off.

specialRules.name: Vomit Attack
specialRules.text: Instead of normal attacks, a single automatic hit at Strength 5 ignoring armour saves.

fighters.name: Snotling Mob
fixedEquipment: Pointy stick (counts as a dagger, gives the enemy +1 armour save or a natural-12 save if he had none; free)

specialRules.name: Mob
specialRules.text: Bought as a mob of 5 for 50gc; replace members for 10gc each up to 5. Always move and fight as a mob, all within 1".

specialRules.name: Weedy
specialRules.text: If wounded: knocked down on 1-2, stunned on 3-6, out of action on 7-12.

specialRules.name: Dodgy
specialRules.text: Natural 12 dodge save against shooting.

specialRules.name: Insignificant
specialRules.text: The whole mob counts as a single model for rout tests, maximum warband size and income. An enemy hero gains experience only for taking the last Snotling out of action.

fighters.notes: Mob of 5 counts as one model.

conversionNotes: Snotling Weedy injury 1 / 2-3 / 4-6 -> 1-2 / 3-6 / 7-12 (proportional, judgement call). Snotling 6+ dodge save and 6+ armour save -> natural 12.
Cave Squig M printed as '2D6'; recorded as M0 with the move rule in specialRules and notes.
Waaagh! Magic is from the Mordheim Annual 2002 and not included in this PDF.

Night Goblin special skills (Ded Shooty, Sneaky Git, Infiltrate, Netter) are not transcribed as fighter data; the PDF has no Strength column checked for Shaman, and Special column marks Big Boss and Boss only.
Fanatic Madcap Mushrooms: Fanatics need them each game; also listed on the main Night Goblin list per 'all Night Goblins' availability.
Snotling Mob treated as a single henchman entry cost 50 (mob of 5), max 1; Snotling profile BS 2 S 2 T 2 per image.
Skill table has ambiguous column positions in the PDF image; read from the rendered page.
